concept.title: Installing the Ceph Object Gateway
concept.shortdesc: To expose Ceph storage to Red Hat Quay, you can install a Ceph Object Gateway on the RADOS gateway node and connect it to your Ceph cluster.

conbody.p: On the Ansible system (ceph05), configure a Ceph Object Gateway to your Ceph Storage cluster (which will ultimately run on ceph04). See Additional resources for details.
